scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to distinct primes p,q with p>=5. It does not assert finiteness or a closed formula for the p-adic threshold H_{p,q}, and it excludes the exceptional small primes 2 and 3. Finite replay is corroborative; the infinite claim rests on Jacobsthal--Ljunggren lifting and p-adic convergence.
title: Prime-power towers for the prime-base binomial congruence
